TECHNOVA SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD.
 MASTER COMPANY KNOWLEDGE BASE
 Founder: Sreehari V S
Company Knowledge Handbook for the AI Company Knowledge Assistant.
 Version 3.0  2026

1. Company Identity and Overview
Legal Name
TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Short Name
TechNova
Company Type
Private limited software and technology company.
Founded
2019.
Founder
Sreehari V S.
Headquarters
Kochi, Kerala, India.
Other Offices
Bengaluru, Karnataka and Pune, Maharashtra.
Industry
Information Technology, Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Data Analytics, and SaaS.
Company Size
Approximately 250 employees in the 2026 company profile.
Mission

Mission
To build practical, reliable technology that helps organizations automate work, understand data, and deliver better
digital services.
Vision
To become a trusted technology partner for organizations adopting cloud, AI, and intelligent software systems.
Tagline
Build Smart. Scale Securely.
Core Values
Customer focus, ownership, continuous learning, collaboration, transparency, engineering excellence, security, and
responsible AI.
Official Website

responsible AI.
Official Website
TechNova's company website is maintained by the organization and provides product, career, and contact
information.

2. Founder and Leadership
Founder — Sreehari V S
Sreehari V S founded TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd. in 2019. He established the company around software
engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and practical business automation.
Founder Background
Sreehari V S has a technical background in computer science and software development and promotes
engineering-led product development.
Chief Executive Officer
Sreehari V S serves as the Founder and Chief Executive Officer.

Chief Technology Officer
Ananya Krishnan leads engineering architecture, platform development, and technical strategy.
Chief Operating Officer
Vivek Nair oversees business operations, delivery, and internal processes.
Head of AI
Dr. Meera Menon leads machine learning, generative AI, NLP, and AI research initiatives.
Leadership Principle
TechNova leadership emphasizes measurable customer value, secure engineering practices, employee learning,
and responsible deployment of AI.

3. Business Areas and Services
Software Product Development
TechNova develops web, mobile, cloud, and enterprise software products.
Artificial Intelligence
Services include machine learning, natural language processing, document intelligence, semantic search,
generative AI, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics.
Cloud Solutions
TechNova provides cloud migration, cloud-native application development, containerization, deployment
automation, and cloud monitoring.
Data Analytics

automation, and cloud monitoring.
Data Analytics
The company develops dashboards, reporting systems, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and business
intelligence solutions.
Full-Stack Development
Engineering teams build frontend and backend applications using modern web technologies and REST or GraphQL
APIs.
Consulting
Technology consulting includes architecture reviews, digital transformation, AI adoption, software modernization,
and engineering process improvement.
Managed Services

Managed Services
Selected enterprise customers receive application maintenance, monitoring, incident response, and technical
support.

4. Products
NovaFlow
A workflow automation platform for approvals, task routing, business process automation, notifications, and
workflow analytics.
NovaAI
An artificial intelligence platform providing document processing, semantic search, question answering, machine
learning APIs, and generative AI capabilities.
NovaInsight
A business analytics platform providing dashboards, scheduled reports, metrics, data exploration, and role-based
analytics access.
NovaCloud

analytics access.
NovaCloud
A cloud management and deployment platform used for application environments, deployment automation,
monitoring, and infrastructure operations.
NovaDesk
A customer support and ticket management product for service requests, incidents, knowledge articles, and
support analytics.

5. Technology Stack
Programming Languages
Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, and Dart are commonly used across teams.
Frontend
React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component libraries.
Backend
Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, and Java-based services.
Databases
PostgreSQL is the primary relational database. MySQL and MongoDB are used for selected applications.
Caching

Caching
Redis is used for caching, session storage, rate limiting, and background job coordination.
AI and ML
Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face models, vector databases, embedding models, and large
language model APIs.
RAG Technologies
Document loaders, text splitters, embeddings, vector similarity search, metadata filtering, retrieval pipelines, prompt
templates, and LLM generation.
DevOps

templates, and LLM generation.
DevOps
Git, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Linux, cloud infrastructure, logging, monitoring, and automated
testing.
APIs
REST APIs and GraphQL APIs are used for application integration. Internal services use authenticated API access.

6. Departments
Engineering
Frontend, backend, mobile, platform, DevOps, QA, and software architecture teams.
Artificial Intelligence
Machine learning, NLP, generative AI, computer vision, data science, and AI platform teams.
Product
Product managers and analysts define product requirements, roadmaps, user stories, and product metrics.
Human Resources
Recruitment, onboarding, employee records, learning, performance management, and employee engagement.
Finance

Finance
Accounting, payroll coordination, budgeting, procurement, invoicing, and financial reporting.
Sales
Customer acquisition, enterprise accounts, proposals, and sales operations.
Marketing
Branding, content, events, campaigns, product communication, and digital marketing.
Customer Success
Customer onboarding, adoption, support coordination, renewals, and customer feedback.
Information Security

Information Security
Security policies, access control, vulnerability management, incident response, and security awareness.

7. Office Locations
Kochi
Headquarters and primary AI and platform engineering center.
Bengaluru
Engineering, enterprise delivery, and technology operations.
Pune
Software engineering, QA, and customer delivery teams.
Office Hours
Standard office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday.
Core Collaboration Hours
10:30 AM to 4:30 PM.
Work Model
Hybrid work is available for eligible employees and teams.
Remote Work

Remote Work
Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week. New employees generally work from the office
during their first four weeks unless an exception is approved.

8. Fresher and Entry-Level Careers
Eligible Qualifications
Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics, and other relevant technical
degrees or equivalent qualifications may be considered.
Typical Fresher Roles
Software Engineer, Python Developer, Java Developer, Frontend Developer, Full-Stack Developer, QA Engineer,
Data Analyst, AI/ML Engineer, Cloud Engineer, and Technical Support Engineer.
General Skills

General Skills
Programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, databases, SQL, Git, problem solving, communication,
debugging, and basic software development concepts.
Fresher Training
Selected engineering freshers complete a 12-week training program.
Training Weeks 1–4
Programming fundamentals, OOP, SQL, databases, Git, debugging, software development lifecycle, and
engineering practices.
Training Weeks 5–8

engineering practices.
Training Weeks 5–8
Frontend, backend, REST APIs, authentication, testing, and application development.
Training Weeks 9–12
Team project, code reviews, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and final evaluation.
Hiring Process
Typical process: online assessment, technical interview, practical coding or project discussion, and HR interview.
Internship Duration
Most internships last between 8 and 16 weeks.
Fresher Growth

Fresher Growth
A typical progression is Graduate Engineer → Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer → Technical Lead
or Engineering Manager, depending on performance and career interests.

9. Employee Working Policies
Working Hours
9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday, normally including a one-hour lunch break.
Attendance
Employees should maintain accurate attendance records and communicate planned absences to their manager.
Flexible Scheduling
Certain teams may use approved flexible schedules based on customer and project requirements.
Hybrid Policy
Eligible employees can work remotely up to two days each week.
Probation

Probation
New employees normally have a six-month probation period unless their employment agreement specifies
otherwise.
Notice Period
The standard notice period is 60 days unless a different period is specified in the employee's employment
agreement.
Overtime
Work beyond normal hours should be planned and approved when required by project or customer commitments.

10. Leave and Holidays
Annual Paid Leave
24 days per calendar year for full-time employees.
Sick Leave
10 days per calendar year.
Public Holidays
12 company holidays are observed each year.
Casual Leave
Casual leave may be granted according to the applicable employee policy and manager approval.
Parental Leave
Eligible employees may receive parental leave according to company policy and applicable law.
Leave Request

Leave Request
Planned leave should normally be submitted at least three working days in advance.
Emergency Leave
Employees should inform their manager as soon as reasonably possible.
Holiday Calendar
Human Resources publishes the annual holiday calendar before the beginning of each year.

11. Compensation and Benefits
Salary Review
Performance and salary reviews normally occur once each year.
Performance Bonus
Eligible employees may receive an annual performance bonus based on individual, team, and company
performance. It is not guaranteed.
Health Insurance
Eligible full-time employees can enroll in company-sponsored health insurance.
Learning Allowance
Employees can claim up to INR 15,000 per calendar year for approved courses, books, certifications, and learning
resources.

resources.
Retirement Benefits
Eligible employees receive statutory retirement and social security benefits according to applicable Indian
regulations.
Employee Recognition
TechNova may provide quarterly recognition awards for exceptional technical contributions, customer impact,
innovation, or teamwork.
Payroll
Salary is processed monthly through the company's payroll system.

12. Recruitment FAQs
Does TechNova hire freshers?
Yes. TechNova recruits freshers for software engineering, QA, data, AI/ML, cloud, and support roles when
openings are available.
What is the typical fresher hiring process?
Online assessment, technical interview, practical coding or project discussion, and HR interview.
What should a fresher prepare?
Programming, OOP, SQL, DBMS, data structures, basic web development, Git, APIs, project knowledge, and
communication.

communication.
Is prior work experience required for fresher roles?
No. Fresher roles are designed for candidates with limited or no professional experience, although internships and
projects are useful.
Are internships available?
Yes. TechNova offers software engineering and AI internships depending on business requirements.
How long is fresher training?
The standard engineering training program lasts 12 weeks.
Can freshers work remotely?

Can freshers work remotely?
Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week, subject to team policy.

13. Engineering Practices
Version Control
Git is used for source code version control.
Branching
Teams generally use feature branches and pull requests for changes.
Code Review
Production code normally requires at least one peer review before merging.
Testing
Projects are expected to include appropriate unit, integration, API, or end-to-end tests.
Documentation
Important services should have setup instructions, API documentation, architecture information, and operational
notes.
Deployment

notes.
Deployment
Applications are deployed through controlled development, testing, and production environments.
Monitoring
Production services should have appropriate logging, health checks, error monitoring, and performance monitoring.

14. Security and Data Protection
Credentials
Passwords, API keys, access tokens, and database credentials must never be committed to public repositories.
Access Control
Employees receive only the access required for their role and project responsibilities.
Confidential Information
Customer data, source code, product plans, credentials, financial information, and non-public business information
are confidential.
Data Handling

are confidential.
Data Handling
Sensitive information must only be stored and processed in approved systems.
AI Tool Usage
Confidential company or customer data must not be submitted to an AI service unless that service is approved for
the relevant data.
Security Incidents
Suspected security incidents must be reported immediately through the internal security reporting process.
Device Security
Company devices should use screen locks, approved security software, and current security updates.

15. AI and Responsible AI Policy
Approved AI Use
AI tools may be used for code assistance, documentation, research, testing, summarization, and approved
business workflows.
Confidentiality
Sensitive company or customer information must not be entered into unapproved AI systems.
Human Oversight
High-impact AI outputs should be reviewed by qualified employees before being used for business decisions.
Accuracy
AI-generated information should be verified when accuracy is important.
Bias and Fairness

Bias and Fairness
AI systems should be evaluated for inappropriate bias and harmful outcomes where relevant.
RAG Systems
RAG applications should retrieve relevant source material, preserve source metadata, and avoid presenting
unsupported claims as facts.

16. Customer Support
Support Channels
Customers can submit support requests through the customer portal or approved support channels.
Priority Levels
Tickets are categorized as Critical, High, Medium, or Low based on business impact and urgency.
Critical Issue
A production outage or severe issue affecting a major business function.
High Issue
A significant degradation or issue affecting an important business function.
Medium Issue
A limited issue with an available workaround.
Low Issue

Low Issue
General questions, minor defects, documentation requests, or low-impact issues.
Support Hours
Standard support operates during business hours. Enterprise customers may have separate support agreements.

17. Projects and Internal Initiatives
AI Knowledge Assistant
An internal RAG-based assistant can retrieve information from approved company documents and answer
employee questions with source references.
Developer Productivity
TechNova invests in CI/CD automation, developer tooling, reusable components, and engineering documentation.
Cloud Modernization
The company is gradually moving suitable workloads toward containerized and cloud-native architectures.
Learning Program

Learning Program
Employees are encouraged to complete technical courses, internal workshops, and professional certifications.
Innovation Program
Employees can propose internal prototypes and proof-of-concept projects through the quarterly innovation
program.

19. Information Boundaries
CEO Salary
The handbook does not provide the CEO's salary.
Individual Salary
The handbook does not provide individual employee salaries.
Customer Confidential Data
No customer confidential data is contained in this knowledge base.
Revenue
No financial revenue figures are provided.
Stock Price
TechNova's stock price is not provided.
Corporate Registration Number
No corporate registration number is provided.
Private Founder Contact Details

Private Founder Contact Details
No personal phone number, home address, or private contact information for Sreehari V S is included.
Unlisted Policies
If a user asks about a policy not contained in this handbook, the RAG assistant should state that the information is
not available in the provided knowledge base rather than inventing it.

20. RAG Grounding Rules
Authoritative Source
For this project, this handbook is the authoritative company knowledge source.
Answer Policy
The assistant should answer using information retrieved from this document.
Unknown Questions
If the retrieved context does not contain the answer, the assistant should say that the information is not available in
the provided company knowledge base.
No Hallucination
The assistant should not invent company facts simply because a question sounds plausible.

Source References
The application should preserve document metadata and, where possible, display the page or section used to
answer a question.
Multiple Sources
When multiple chunks are relevant, the assistant may combine them while keeping the answer grounded in
retrieved content.
RAG Evaluation
The application should be tested with questions whose answers are in the document and questions whose answers
are intentionally absent.
